sanskrit_verse:
निषाद एकपुत्रस्तु विप्रस्य स तृतीयभाक् ।
द्वौ सकुल्याः सपिण्डावा स्वधादाताथ संहरेत् ॥
transliteration: niṣāda ekaputras tu viprasya sa tṛtīyabhāk | dvau sakulyāḥ sapiṇḍā vā svadhādātātha saṃharet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When a Niṣāda begets a son through a Vipra woman, that son receives one-third share; two kulyas or sapindas shall take the remainder upon performance of svadha.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from ritual completion, not lineage alone
Causation follows conscious participation in dharma-kriya
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with spiritual status at time of act
Restoration logic prioritizes continuity of offering over bloodline
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor performs svadha THEN entitled to residual estate distribution
IF lineage is disputed AND svadha has been performed by non-heir THEN distribute two parts among sakulya/sapinda
IF birthright contested THEN verify presence of svadha before asserting third-share claim
IF no svadha performed AND no sapinda present THEN default to niṣāda line continuation
supreme_court_application: In matters of inheritance where caste-origin and ritual action conflict, the court must prioritize evidence of svadha performance. Lineage alone does not confer entitlement without dharmic completion. Where such acts are proven, even non-traditional heirs may assume custodianship of property.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana-based determination confirms svadha as causal factor in determining heir eligibility. Anupurvasah shows that spiritual action supersedes biological origin. Proportional responsibility assigns shares based on active participation in sustaining ancestral continuity. This upholds Nyaya while rejecting punitive exclusion of any participant.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process requires public acknowledgment of svadha performance
Responsibility assumption protocol allows sapinda to affirm guardianship within 30 days
Capacity restoration involves purification rituals for all parties involved
Integrity reintegration includes ceremonial reaffirmation of family unity post-settlement
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. Inheritance flows not from punishment but from conscious alignment with svadha. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
